ORGANIZATION.TITLE: CRM Organizational Structure
ORGANIZATION.HELP: Configure the group, internal companies, business units, departments/teams and each user's coverage. Internal companies reuse the Master Company record and departments reuse native JRC Conversas Teams.
ORGANIZATION.PERMISSION_NOTE: Organizational coverage and functional permissions are separate concepts. This step records where a team/person may operate; allowed actions continue to come from native roles and permissions.
ORGANIZATION.GROUP_HELP: The Account remains the tenant. The name below is only the organizational label displayed in CRM and does not create another tenant.
ORGANIZATION.COMPANIES_HELP: Distinct operating companies. They are Master Company records with Internal relationship, not parallel CRM company records.
ORGANIZATION.UNITS_HELP: Each company can have zero, one or many units. Legacy units without a company stay visible for review and are never linked automatically.
ORGANIZATION.DEPARTMENTS_HELP: Reuses native Teams. A department can be local or shared by the group, such as Finance, Backoffice or Support.
ORGANIZATION.DEPARTMENT_COVERAGE_HELP: Define whether a department serves the whole group, one company or one business unit.
ORGANIZATION.USER_COVERAGE_HELP: A manager can limit each user to selected companies and units. When a team is selected, the user's coverage must stay inside the team's coverage.
ORGANIZATION.NAME: Name
ORGANIZATION.ENFORCE_SCOPE: Apply organizational limits to CRM visibility
ORGANIZATION.ENFORCE_SCOPE_HELP: Opt-in and restrictive only: configured users are limited to their assigned companies/units, but this never grants access to other owners records or replaces roles and permissions. Administrators keep native access.
ORGANIZATION.ERROR: Unable to update the organizational structure.
ORGANIZATION.COMPANY_CREATED: Internal company created in the Master Directory.

ORGANIZATION.TEAM_CREATED: Department/team created using the native Team structure.
